verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 runs agent code in an isolated cloud computer, not on the user's host (docs-1, docs-28). Its credential features authenticate outbound traffic without placing raw secret material inside the sandbox process (docs-15), and SandboxNetworkPolicy adds outbound traffic controls (docs-13). Missing for 10: details on the isolation boundary mechanism (e.g. VM or kernel separation), independent or hands-on corroboration that secrets cannot be reached from inside the sandbox.
